name: phaenon/runtime
description: Runtime support for code compiled from Phaenon: the \Phaenon\Type descriptor behind `is` / `as` on structural types, the checked conversions of \Phaenon\Bytes between binary data and UTF-8 text, and the line map reader that points Monolog records and Sentry events at .phn source positions

suggest.monolog/monolog: ^3.0: Phaenon\Debug\Monolog\LineMapProcessor writes .phn source positions of logged exceptions
suggest.sentry/sentry: ^4.0: Phaenon\Debug\Sentry\LineMapIntegration sends .phn source positions and context lines to Sentry
